en: Color view over a busy northern European harbor with many cranes, docked cargo ships, and a white passenger ship moving through the water. In the foreground are small marinas with pleasure boats, red wooden waterfront buildings, and a brick church with a small steeple. Rolling green hills and an industrial port area line the distant shore under a partly cloudy sky. The image has the typical border and print style of a mid‑20th‑century postcard.
